types.label: I appear in this video and want it removed
types.needs: We may ask you to confirm your identity by replying from the email you give. Include the title or link and the point in the video where you appear.

types.label: Copyright complaint
types.needs: Say which work is yours, where it appears, and how you own it. Include a link to the original.

types.label: Illegal or abusive content
types.needs: Describe what you saw and where. Do not forward, copy or download the content.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Choose the reason and describe what you saw. You get a reference number straight away.

steps.title: Acknowledge
steps.body: We confirm the request is in the queue.

steps.title: Hold
steps.body: A reviewer can hide the video while the request is checked. Hidden videos are kept on record, not deleted.

steps.title: Decide
steps.body: A reviewer removes, restricts or keeps the video, and writes down why.

steps.title: Tell you
steps.body: We email the outcome and the reason to the address you gave, with how to appeal.

steps.title: Record
steps.body: The request, the decision and the dates stay in the audit log.
